summary.en: Adds secure self-service onboarding, granular meeting-history access controls, expanded administration tools, and refreshed platform dependencies.

description.en: Administrators can enable self-registration with domain allow-lists, email verification, optional approval, and configurable password policies.
Deactivating a user now ends active sessions, while token-version checks protect API and realtime authentication.
Platform defaults and per-channel rules can limit access to past meetings based on channel membership or membership at meeting start.
Batched authorization checks and new database indexes improve access to meetings, search results, and related files.
Dedicated meeting, registration, and SMTP settings add pending-registration alerts and protect administrator-managed mail configuration.
The login and registration flow is refreshed, and the update center uses the corrected official feed endpoint.
Updated DOMPurify, Socket.IO parser, Feathers commons, Vite and esbuild, plus the desktop PTT helper dependency set.

en: Back up PostgreSQL and both Garage volumes and test a restore before updating.
Redeploy backend and frontend from the shared v0.3.0 release tag.
